City of Encinitas
Zoning Administrative Hearing
AGENDA
MARCH 23, 2021 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
Item 4A is located within the Coastal Zone and requires the issuance of a regular Coastal Development Permit. The action of the Zoning Administrator on Item 4A may not be appealed to the California Coastal Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
4.
REGULAR AGENDA
4A.
PROJECT NAME: McLaughlin Single-Family Residence; CASE NUMBER: MULTI-004376-2021, USE-004377-2021, and CDP-003516-2020; FILING DATE: December 17, 2019; APPLICANT: Kevan McLaughlin; LOCATION: 1212 Hymettus Avenue (APN 254-262-05); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: A public hearing to consider a Minor Use Permit and Coastal Development Permit for the demolition of an existing single-family residence and all onsite accessory structures for the construction of a new principal two-story single-family residence including an accessory dwelling unit (ADU), an oversized accessory recreation room, and site improvements; ZONING/OVERLAY: The subject property is located in the Residential 3 (R-3) zone and the Coastal Overlay Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Sections 15301(l)(1) and 15303(a). Section 15301(1)(1) exempts the demolition of a single-family residence and all accessory structures. Section 15303(a) exempts the construction of a new principal two-story single-family residence, an accessory dwelling units (ADU), and accessory recreation room;
STAFF CONTACT: J. Dichoso, AICP, Associate Planner, 760-633-2681, jdichoso@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
McLaughlin Single-Family Residence Staff Report
5.
ADJOURNMENT
